title: mini glass tree ornaments
text: mini glass tree ornaments. These are just perfect for a little tree I have (stands about 2" tall and is a stick tree that I change the decor to match season).  They are about 1" They come in nicely separated box... but no hooks or ribbons.  In my case I didn't need hooks or ribbons because I have little stick branches.  They are quite lovely for the size and price.  They will work for many years if you put back in their boxes.  In my opinion a great price.
